summary: Coya Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing its October 5, 2026 press release announcing full enrollment of the planned 120 patients in the ongoing Phase 2/3 ALSTARS trial (NCT07161999) of COYA 302, a combination low-dose IL-2 and CTLA-4 Ig, for ALS. The randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study uses 1:1:1 allocation across two dosing regimens and placebo over a 24-week phase, followed by a 24-week blinded active extension. Topline data are anticipated in early Q2 2027. No corporate transaction, price, stake, or board recommendation is involved, so the filing is a routine clinical milestone disclosure, not a special situation.
